text.tspan: The previous confirmation does not authorize the new price.
Source: UC-30 NF1–7, A1–A4, E1–E2; BR143; §4 Data Integrity

SRS-based logical interaction model. Boundary / API / control lifelines represent responsibilities, not unspecified code classes, methods, endpoints or HTTP status codes. UI labels and messages are translated into English for these diagrams; SRS message IDs are retained.

Preconditions: valid session, required role, active Student account; JWT authentication under Section 5.2.1. No HTTP method, request-key format or database locking mechanism is specified here. Rechecking and exchange must satisfy NF4–5 and ACID integrity.

[one exchange; ACID and idempotency — Section 4 / UC-30 NF5]
